title: Watertight checkpoint enforcement in voyage batch
description: Non-watertight meshes are checkpointed and count toward best similarity. Agent gets no feedback that its mesh is open. Fix: gate _maybe_checkpoint() on watertight status — reject non-watertight meshes and return feedback to the agent via _visual_round_callback. Remove post-hoc watertight gate.
definition-of-done: 1. _maybe_checkpoint rejects non-watertight meshes before checkpointing. 2. Rejection returns feedback dict with reason and guidance. 3. _visual_round_callback injects rejection message into agent messages. 4. Post-hoc watertight error flag removed from best checkpoint selection.
testing-plan: 1. During a voyage run, agent produces non-watertight DSL. 2. Verify no checkpoint is created. 3. Verify agent receives rejection feedback message. 4. Only watertight meshes appear in checkpoint_history.
